nodes.name: Theorem 3
nodes.statement:
{\normalfont (\textbf{Completeness, Soundness of Conditional Adjustment Criterion for MPDAGs})}
    Let $\mathbf{X,Y}, \mathbf{Z}$, and $\mathbf{S}$ be pairwise disjoint node sets in a causal MPDAG $\mathcal{G}$, where $\mathbf{Z} \cap \mathrm{PossDe}(\mathbf{X},\mathcal{G}) = \emptyset$. Then $\mathbf{S}$ is a conditional adjustment set relative to $(\mathbf{X,Y,Z})$ in $\mathcal{G}$ (Definition 1) if and only if $\mathbf{S}$ satisfies the conditional adjustment criterion relative to $(\mathbf{X,Y,Z})$ in $\mathcal{G}$ (Definition 2).

nodes.name: Theorem 39
nodes.statement:
{\normalfont (\textbf{Completeness of the Conditional Adjustment Criterion for DAGs})}
    Let $\mathbf{X}$, $\mathbf{Y}$, $\mathbf{Z}$, and $\mathbf{S}$ be pairwise disjoint node sets in a causal DAG $\mathcal{D}$, where $\mathbf{Z} \cap \mathrm{De}(\mathbf{X}, \mathcal{D}) = \emptyset$. If $\mathbf{S}$ is a conditional adjustment set relative to $(\mathbf{X,Y,Z})$ in $\mathcal{D}$ (Definition 1), then $\mathbf{S}$ satisfies the conditional adjustment criterion relative to $(\mathbf{X,Y,Z})$ in $\mathcal{D}$ (Definition 2).

nodes.name: Theorem 40
nodes.statement:
{\normalfont (\textbf{Soundness of the Conditional Adjustment Criterion for DAGs})}
    Let $\mathbf{X,Y,Z}$, and $\mathbf{S}$ be pairwise disjoint node sets in a causal DAG $\mathcal{D}$, where $\mathbf{Z} \cap \mathrm{De}(\mathbf{X}, \mathcal{D}) = \emptyset$. If $\mathbf{S}$ satisfies the conditional adjustment criterion relative to $(\mathbf{X,Y, Z})$ in $\mathcal{D}$ (Definition 2), then $\mathbf{S}$ is a conditional adjustment set relative to $(\mathbf{X,Y,Z})$ in $\mathcal{D}$ (Definition 1).

nodes.name: Lemma 41
nodes.statement:
Let $\mathbf{X}$, $\mathbf{Y}$, $\mathbf{Z}$, and $\mathbf{S}$ be pairwise disjoint node sets in a causal DAG $\mathcal{D}$, where $\mathbf{Z} \cap \mathrm{De}(\mathbf{X}, \mathcal{D}) = \emptyset$ and where $\mathbf{S}$ satisfies the conditional adjustment criterion relative to $(\mathbf{X,Y,Z})$ in $\mathcal{D}$ (Definition 2). Let $\mathbf{H} \subseteq \mathrm{An}(\mathbf{X} \cup \mathbf{Y},\mathcal{D}) \setminus (\mathrm{De}(\mathbf{X}, \mathcal{D}) \cup \mathbf{Y} \cup \mathbf{Z})$ and $\mathbf{\tilde{S}} = \mathbf{S} \cup \mathbf{H}$. Then:
    \begin{enumerate}[label = (\roman*)]
        \item  $\mathbf{\tilde{S}}$ satisfies the conditional adjustment criterion relative to $(\mathbf{X,Y,Z})$ in $\mathcal{D}$, and
        \item  $\int_{\mathbf{s}} f(\mathbf{y} | \mathbf{x,z,s})f(\mathbf{s} | \mathbf{z}) \mathop{}\!\mathrm{d} \mathbf{s} = \int_{\mathbf{\tilde{s}}} f(\mathbf{y} | \mathbf{x,z,\tilde{s}}) f(\mathbf{\tilde{s}} | \mathbf{z})  \mathop{}\!\mathrm{d} \mathbf{\tilde{s}}$, for any density $f$ consistent with $\mathcal{D}$.
    \end{enumerate}

nodes.name: Lemma 42
nodes.statement:
Let $\mathbf{X},\mathbf{Y}, \mathbf{Z}$, and $\mathbf{S}$ be pairwise disjoint node sets in a causal DAG $\mathcal{D}$, where $\mathbf{Z} \cap \mathrm{De}(\mathbf{X}, \mathcal{D}) = \emptyset$ and where $\mathbf{S}$ satisfies the conditional adjustment criterion relative to $(\mathbf{X,Y,Z})$ in $\mathcal{D}$ (Definition 2). Let $\mathbf{H} = \mathrm{An}(\mathbf{X} \cup \mathbf{Y},\mathcal{D}) \setminus (\mathrm{De}(\mathbf{X}, \mathcal{D}) \cup \mathbf{Y} \cup \mathbf{Z})$ and $\mathbf{\tilde{S}} = \mathbf{S} \cup \mathbf{H}$. Additionally, let $\mathbf{\tilde{S}_D} = \mathbf{\tilde{S}} \cap \mathrm{De}(\mathbf{X}, \mathcal{D})$, $\mathbf{\tilde{S}_N} = \mathbf{\tilde{S}} \setminus \mathrm{De}(\mathbf{X}, \mathcal{D})$, $\mathbf{Y_D} = \mathbf{Y} \cap \mathrm{De}(\mathbf{X},\mathcal{D})$, and $\mathbf{Y_N} = \mathbf{Y} \setminus \mathrm{De}(\mathbf{X}, \mathcal{D})$. Then the following statements hold:
    \begin{enumerate}[label=(\roman*)] 

        \item $(\mathbf{X} \cup \mathbf{Y_N} \cup \mathbf{\tilde{S}} \cup \mathbf{Z}) \cap \mathrm{Forb}(\mathbf{X,Y},\mathcal{D}) = \emptyset$,

        \item if $p = \langle H, \dots, Y_D \rangle$ is a non-causal path in $\mathcal{D}$ from $H \in \mathbf{X} \cup \mathbf{Y_N} \cup \mathbf{\tilde{S}} \cup \mathbf{Z}$ to a node $Y_D \in \mathbf{Y_D}$, then $p$ is blocked by $(\mathbf{X} \cup \mathbf{Y_N} \cup \mathbf{\tilde{S}_N} \cup \mathbf{Z}) \setminus \{H\}$,

        \item  $\mathbf{Y_D} \perp_{d} \mathbf{\tilde{S}_D} \:\vert\: \mathbf{Y_N} \cup \mathbf{X} \cup \mathbf{\tilde{S}_N} \cup \mathbf{Z}$ in $\mathcal{D}$,

        \item  if $\mathbf{Y_N} = \emptyset$, then $\mathbf{\tilde{S}_N}$ is a conditional adjustment set relative to $(\mathbf{X,Y,Z})$ in $\mathcal{D}$ (Definition 1),

        \item  the empty set is an adjustment set relative to $(\mathbf{X} \cup \mathbf{Y_N} \cup \mathbf{\tilde{S}_N} \cup \mathbf{Z}, \mathbf{Y_D})$ in $\mathcal{D}$ (Definition 11),

        \item  $\mathbf{Y_D} \perp_{d} (\mathbf{Y_N} \cup \mathbf{\tilde{S}_N} \cup \mathbf{Z}) \:\vert\: \mathbf{X}$ in $\mathcal{D}_{\overline{\mathbf{X}}\underline{\mathbf{Y_N} \cup  \mathbf{\tilde{S}_N} \cup \mathbf{Z}}}$, and

        \item  $\mathbf{\tilde{S}_N} \perp_{d} \mathbf{X} \:\vert\: \mathbf{Y_N} \cup \mathbf{Z}$ in $\mathcal{D}_{\overline{\mathbf{X}}}$.
    \end{enumerate}

nodes.name: Lemma 6
nodes.statement:
Let $\mathbf{X}$, $\mathbf{Y}$, $\mathbf{Z}$, and $\mathbf{S}$ be pairwise disjoint node sets in an MPDAG $\mathcal{G}$, where $\mathbf{Z} \cap \mathrm{PossDe}(\mathbf{X}, \mathcal{G}) = \emptyset$. Then we have the following.
    \begin{enumerate}[label=\emph{(\alph*)}]
        \item \textbf{Comparison of Adjustment Criteria:}\\ 
        $\mathbf{S}$ satisfies the conditional adjustment criterion relative to $(\mathbf{X,Y,Z})$ in $\mathcal{G}$ (Definition 2) if and only if $\mathbf{S} \cup \mathbf{Z}$ satisfies the adjustment criterion relative to $(\mathbf{X}, \mathbf{Y})$ in $\mathcal{G}$ (Definition 12, Supp.\ A). 
        
        \item \textbf{Comparison of Adjustment Sets:}\\
        $\mathbf{S}$ is a conditional adjustment set relative to $(\mathbf{X,Y,Z})$ in $\mathcal{G}$ (Definition 1) if and only if $\mathbf{S} \cup \mathbf{Z}$ is an adjustment set relative to $(\mathbf{X}, \mathbf{Y})$ in $\mathcal{G}$ (Definition 11, Supp.\ A). 
    \end{enumerate}

nodes.name: Lemma 49
nodes.statement:
Let $\mathbf{X}$ and $\mathbf{Z}$ be disjoint node sets in a PAG $\mathcal{G}$. Then the following statements are equivalent.
    \begin{enumerate}[label = (\roman*)]
        \item $\mathbf{Z} \cap \mathrm{PossDe}(\mathbf{X},\mathcal{G}) = \emptyset$. 
        \item $\mathbf{Z} \cap \mathrm{De}(\mathbf{X},\mathcal{D}) = \emptyset$ in every DAG $\mathcal{D}$ represented by $\mathcal{G}$. 
    \end{enumerate}
